fetch_minutes.description:
Download the feed again after this many minutes. The countdown
updates every refresh either way.

path.description: A local `.ics` file instead of a URL. `~/` is expanded.

show_past.description: Also list events that have already ended.

url.description:
The feed's URL (`webcal://` works too). Fine for a public calendar;
for a private address use `url_env` or `url_command`.

url_command.description: Command that prints the feed's URL, e.g. `["op", "read", "op://me/calendar/url"]`.

url_env.description: Environment variable holding the feed's URL.

warn_minutes.description: The tile turns yellow this many minutes before a meeting.

entries.description: Today's agenda from an iCalendar (.ics) feed or file, with the next meeting and its join link. Google, Outlook and iCloud all publish a private .ics address, so no sign-in is needed. Handles repeating events and time zones.
entries.name: Calendar
